I genuinely expected professionalism and transparency from Tata Motors’ authorized dealership, but unfortunately my overall experience with this showroom has been extremely poor and frustrating.

I strongly recommend customers to:

* Take every commitment in writing
* Record fuel level before handing over the car
* Remove personal belongings before service/accessories work

Service Experience Review – Keshva Motors, Nahur/Mulund
Date: 17-Jan-2025
Rating:  (3/5)
Tata Safari : First Free Service 2k KMs

I had an appointment at 10:30 AM, as advised. Unfortunately, the experience started on a slow and unorganized note.

Even after reaching on time, no one attended to me until 10:58 AM. The first call from the service centre came at 10:47 AM, just to check whether I had reached, despite me already being present. The waiting area doubles as a back-office workspace, which was confusing and uncomfortable.

The customer lounge is located on the mezzanine floor and can seat around 6 people comfortably. There is a small window overlooking the workshop, but since my vehicle was never taken inside the workshop, I could not see any work being done.

The job card process started around 11:00 AM with the service advisor, Shivam. Issues reported by me included:

Middle-row seat tumble not working

Two loose screws found in the glove box (left during accessory installation)

Pending software update (last version: R16.43 – May 2025)

I opted out of interior deep cleaning as there didn’t seem to be a proper area for it, and I was concerned it might make things worse.

I overheard another customer almost being turned away due to DEF unavailability, though DEF was later arranged for them.

At 12:50 PM, I was informed that the car was ready. However:

The software update was not done initially, and I had to wait another ~25 minutes for a technician to arrive with a pen drive.

The update finally started at 1:48 PM. Although the pen drive had R17.37, they installed R17.16 instead (previous version was R16.43).

Seat tumble issue was fixed.

DEF was not topped up, even though the level was around 60%. I was told they cannot open a 15-litre DEF can for a small top-up (3–5 litres). Possibly restricted due to my Gold AMC.

Interior and exterior wash was done well, though minor stains remained.
